claim: Community research identifies arch06 archives by the 4-byte magic 'LTAR' followed by a u32 version, but the public ImHex pattern maps only a short header and no file table, compression or index.
evidence: arch06.hexpat is 12 lines: magic LTAR, version, four unknown u32 and 25 padding bytes.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN - source does not state a game build; not checked against 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001
verification_method: Read the pattern file in the cloned repo. Against our build: read the first 64 bytes of a copied Patch_00.arch06 and compare magic/version (read-only, outside the game dir).
limitations: No public arch06 extractor or QuickBMS script was found by web search; compression is not documented (oo2core_5_win64.dll in the game dir suggests Oodle, unverified). LTAR prefix is consistent with LithTech ARchive naming but that is inference.
next_experiment: Hex-dump headers of all *.arch06 files from a copy, tabulate version/unknown fields across Patch_00..13 and region archives; look for Oodle block signatures.
